message: I've always been a bit of a fire safety nerd, and let me tell you, it feels pretty good to be the one reminding my friends about how to prep for fire emergencies. Whether it's knowing the best escape routes or having a plan in place, being informed is key. It's one of those things where you think, "I told you so" when you realize how just a little preparation can make a big difference. What’s your go-to tip for fire safety?
